goal: Keep finished private broadcast transactions in memory so node operators can inspect broadcast history
Report peer acknowledgment details and echo reception timestamps after a broadcast finishes
agreement: Concept approval because keeping finished broadcast history is useful for users (optout21)
Prior bug preventing retries for un-echoed transactions was resolved in review (frankomosh)
Open suggestion to keep the received flag on re-broadcast if the transaction is in mempool (optout21)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it improves diagnostics for private broadcast without affecting network relay or consensus
Node operators gain visibility into send times and network echo reception for finished transactions
